entries.title: Permutation-equivariant candidate-set information exchange

sources.title: Set-Encoder: Permutation-Invariant Inter-Passage Attention for Listwise Passage Re-Ranking with Cross-Encoders

source_facts: Passage interaction tokens share representations without passage-order positions
Ordinary relevance pointwise model can be similarly effective; clearer benefit for novelty task
Original text/ELECTRA/A10040GB setup and fine-tuning stages differ
Inspected author module imports core architecture from lightning-ir
entries.our_adaptation: B41 row embeddings width32; one2head candidate self-attention block without candidate positions, shared score head; same query-weighted BCE as controls; full real C including zeroY queries
entries.novelty_delta: Forward information exchange between candidate rows; different from listwise loss and from M05 attention over user history
entries.information_limit: Same per-row columns but expanded access to other candidate rows; not literally same information as a pointwise learner
inputs: Existing strict-past B41 numeric/missing values for every actual C row
entries.counterhypothesis: B41 already represents useful intent; set context repeats retrieval composition; relational model overfits sparse purchase support

own_literal_falsifier.meaning: Context can change A/B order despite unchanged A/B rows; mean-context control also solves toy. Permutation invariance alone does not establish padding correctness; not evidence REES labels follow this rule

matched_controls: Same MLP plus per-query mean/max of41columns
gates: Same-second peers and future suffix invariance
Explicit missing policy and no label-derived query statistics
entries.temporal: Training X strict-past; complete standalone learner/transforms freeze before first future evaluation; no backfilled learned context feature into earlier downstream anchors
entries.promotion: Incremental ranking benefit over cheap list summaries and strong B with same candidate coverage; otherwise stop

entries.title: Automatically discovered cross-mistake training environments
source_facts: Twins trained on random halves imitate confident held-out mistakes through dynamic discovery labels
Cross-mistakes use either twin prediction error against original y
Driver annotates train and validation; author pipeline includes GroupDRO/RWG
Paper explicitly discusses causal/observational non-identifiability and failure cases
entries.our_adaptation: Training-only B41 small twins, whole-user split rather than row split; one fixed discovery setting. Original labels restored for downstream B41 fitting. Compare static class-environment balancing against original/class-balanced/shuffled-environment weights; not a full GroupDRO reproduction
entries.novelty_delta: Learn environment assignment before weighting, beyond old fixed user/query weights; weight formula alone not claimed new
entries.weight_contract: Base a_qi=1/|Cq|; each class-env loss sum(a*ell)/sum(a), groups equal mass. Empty groups stop. Shuffle m within original class preserving exact class-env counts and same formula
inputs: Training-only user identifiers for split/exclusion, not ordinal model features
entries.counterhypothesis: Discovery partitions rare classes, arbitrary noise or support/repeat rather than stable nuisance; easy repeat signal may be invariant and incorrectly downweighted

own_literal_falsifier.meaning: Presence/nondegeneracy does not imply recovering the real environment; source trivial all-negative class collapse is correctly rejected

matched_controls: Within-class m-shuffled balanced B41 with same group counts
gates: No validation annotation/search from author driver
Class-env support by independent users/days and fixed minimum support
entries.temporal: All discovery/train labels mature by fit cutoff; m never inference feature because it requires y; final B available before future predictions; early FE extension would need separate forward snapshots

finite_proposal.explanation: Two twins conservatively counted separately even with joint optimizer, plus4boosters

entries.memory_plan: Stream X and annotation; approximately one byte per binary row assignment before keys/caches; avoid simultaneous transformed copies
entries.promotion: Meaningful future fullY ranking benefit beyond class balancing and matched shuffled environments; no causal/fairness/universal OOD interpretation

entries.title: Class-clamped diffusion perturbations of training features

sources.title: TabDiff: a Mixed-type Diffusion Model for Tabular Data Generation

source_facts: Joint mixed numeric/categorical diffusion with feature-specific schedules
Documented CLI imputes target from features; generic masks support proposed reversed conditioning wrapper
Original RTX A4000 16GB; no foundation checkpoint required
steps8000 traverses full loader per epoch
Built-in generation evaluation may train downstream utility evaluators
entries.our_adaptation: Dataset-specific generator on permitted B41 train X plus mature categorical y. Clamp parent query/user context and encoded y=1, mask fixed candidate-specific primitive subset, guidance off; recompute deterministic feature descendants, reject invalid dependencies. Generate <=4accepted perturbations per original covered positive; no synthetic real Q/C/Y events
entries.novelty_delta: Learned conditional training-support smoothing, distinct from loss shaping, representation ensembling or extra observed-task heads
entries.conditional_support_limit: Executable masking supports a plausible wrapper, not author-tested rare-purchase augmentation or guaranteed exact conditional density. Output label token preservation does not establish relevance
inputs: Predeclared grammar-derived primitive/dependency map and context clamp mask
entries.weight_contract: Original positive mass split among original+accepted perturbations; duplicate control mirrors accepted count and weights per parent. Query/class total mass conserved. No synthetic rows counted as independent purchases or used as evaluation candidates
entries.counterhypothesis: Few real positives cause memorization/mode collapse; feasible generated positive tuples cross negative support; rare-label conditioning ignored

other_gates: Identical features plus random winners cannot gain ranking information or independent evidence from synthetic copies

gates: Exact primitive/context/mask closure specified before fits
Source-free conditional sampler smoke on legal/illegal toy tuples
Disable author automatic downstream evaluation fits and online logging
Bounded final checkpoint path independent of epoch4000 best-checkpoint convention
entries.temporal: Train-only transforms/generator/checkpoint/synthetic filtering within permitted fit domain; no future/evaluation rows; final downstream learner available before future scoring; no generated source events or early feature snapshots
entries.promotion: Incremental real chronological fullY ranking benefit over matched duplication, with legal support and actual affordable total cost. Short bounded schedule may simply fail; paper synthesis quality not promised
